evidence.quote: mature osteoblast/osteocyte-specific ablation of PPARgamma in mice (Ocy-PPARgamma-/-) alters body composition with age, namely, to produce less fat and more lean mass, and enhances insulin sensitivity and energy expenditure compared with wild-type mice. In addition, Ocy-PPARgamma-/- mice exhibit more bone density, structure, and strength by uncoupling bone formation from resorption. When challenged with a high-fat diet, Ocy-PPARgamma-/- mice retain glycemic control, with increased browning of the adipose tissue, decreased gluconeogenesis, and less hepatic steatosis.

experiment.endpoint: body composition, insulin sensitivity, energy expenditure, glycemic control, adipose browning, gluconeogenesis, hepatic steatosis, bone density/structure/strength
